notes_for_editor: Thin record. Two searches and the catalog and TopoQuest pages gave no build date, builder, height, fate or present-day description, so the story says only what those pages support. Elevation conflict: 1873 ft (tnlandforms, which matches the record's 570.9 m) against 1879 ft (TopoQuest); the record keeps 570.9 m. Coordinates match TopoQuest (36.510666, -82.073182) to rounding. The Civilian Conservation Corps sentence is state context, not a claim that Big Creek was a CCC tower. A Tennessee Division of Forestry record or a Sullivan County history would be the best next source. Search hits for Big Creek towers in Washington and Idaho and for McQueen Knob are different sites and were not used.
